blocks.text: Why realtors need a faster workflow on Mac

Real estate agents face a constant battle between client-facing time and back-office work. When you use Zoom for realtors on Mac, you are often juggling multiple browser tabs, CRM entries, and document signing tools simultaneously. The average agent spends 65 percent of their week on administrative tasks. This leaves little room for actual selling or lead generation. Using a voice assistant like Lazur allows you to keep your focus on the client while managing your Mac in the background.
Essential Zoom tips for real estate agents

To stay professional during virtual tours, you must master the Zoom interface. Always check your camera and microphone settings before a client call. Use the [how-to/grant-camera-access-in-zoom](/how-to/grant-camera-access-in-zoom) guide to ensure your system settings allow Zoom to function properly. If your background is cluttered, use the [how-to/change-your-virtual-background-in-zoom](/how-to/change-your-virtual-background-in-zoom) feature to maintain a clean, branded look.

items: Use ⌘ ⇧ M to mute yourself quickly when you are not speaking.
Use ⌘ ⇧ S to start or stop your screen share for property walkthroughs.
Use ⌘ ⇧ H to toggle the meeting chat window for quick client questions.
Always use a wired internet connection if possible to avoid lag during tours.
Keep your Zoom client updated to the latest version to avoid connection errors.

blocks.text: During a Zoom call, you might need to find a property listing or pull up a contract. Doing this manually while talking can be distracting. Instead, ask Lazur to help you navigate your Mac. You can hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask where a specific file is or how to open a required application. This keeps your visual focus on the Zoom window where your client is.
Avoiding common Mac mistakes in Zoom

Many agents struggle with screen sharing issues. If your screen share shows a black box, it is often a permission issue in macOS. Follow the [how-to/fix-a-black-screen-share-in-zoom](/how-to/fix-a-black-screen-share-in-zoom) steps to resolve this. Another common error is forgetting to share computer sound when playing a video of a property. Use [how-to/share-computer-sound-in-zoom](/how-to/share-computer-sound-in-zoom) to ensure your clients hear the audio clearly.

Lazur acts as your personal assistant on your Mac. You can dictate notes into your CRM or email client immediately after a meeting. Hold the fn key to dictate clean, formatted text. This is much faster than typing notes manually after every call. Lazur does not click buttons for you, but it guides you to the right place so you can finish your work faster.
The importance of the right hardware

Zoom performs best on Apple Silicon Macs. If you are using an older Intel-based Mac, you may notice performance drops when using virtual backgrounds or high-resolution screen sharing. Ensure your macOS is updated to the latest version to keep your hardware running efficiently. Check your system requirements using the [how-to/check-system-requirements-in-zoom](/how-to/check-system-requirements-in-zoom) guide.

For larger meetings or open house events on Zoom, use the [how-to/set-up-a-waiting-room-in-zoom](/how-to/set-up-a-waiting-room-in-zoom) feature. This allows you to manage entry and keep your meeting secure. If you need to record a session for a client who could not attend, use the [how-to/record-a-meeting-in-zoom](/how-to/record-a-meeting-in-zoom) steps to save the video directly to your Mac.

faq.question: Can Lazur click buttons in Zoom for me?
faq.answer: No, Lazur does not click buttons or operate Zoom for you. It points at things on your screen and guides you through the steps so you can perform the actions yourself.

faq.question: Is Lazur safe to use for private client meetings?
faq.answer: Yes, Lazur only looks at your screen and listens to your voice while you hold the activation keys. No data is stored, and your content is never used to train AI models.

faq.question: How do I fix a black screen when sharing my screen on a Mac?
faq.answer: This is usually a macOS permission issue. Check your System Settings under Privacy and Security to ensure Zoom has permission for screen recording.

faq.question: What is the best way to speed up my Zoom workflow?
faq.answer: Master the keyboard shortcuts for Zoom and use a voice assistant like Lazur to manage your Mac navigation and dictate notes quickly.
